title: Pokémon cards made the Hall of Fame: the week in cards
intro: One free email every Sunday with the week in cards. Here's the latest issue as a magazine: tap the cover to open it, and sign up free at the bottom of the page.
opening: Zia and Luna here with your Sunday shuffle: your binder is now a museum piece, Rayquaza is back and Star Trek is warping into Magic.
image_alt: Zia reports on the Pokémon TCG joining the National Toy Hall of Fame

p: Pokémon joins the Toy Hall of Fame.

The Pokémon Trading Card Game was inducted into the National Toy Hall of Fame's class of 2026 on November 6, alongside Bingo, Care Bears and the playground slide. All those years of sleeving, trading and binder-guarding? Certified classic.

li: Pokémon: Delta Reign is out, Mega Rayquaza returns.
Mega Evolution: Delta Reign released November 6, bringing Mega Rayquaza back for the first time in over a decade.
Prerelease started November 6 (six Play Boosters, a foil promo, a deck box and a spindown die per pack). It lands on MTG Arena November 10 and releases November 13.
Lorcana: My Adventure Book is banned.
Out of Core Constructed since November 3; Ravensburger says it gave decks with few or no characters too much consistency.
Pokémon: Happy Meals are back November 10.
Participating US McDonald's restaurants bring 15 mini box toys and 15 collectible cards.
The 250-card set has over 60 Showcase cards and reaches retail April 30, 2027.
Riftbound: The T1 bundle goes to a drawing.
The T1 Player Bundle, with Champion cards picked by Faker and team, joins one online drawing open November 13-16.
Flesh and Blood: One Lotus and Ancients Awaken get dates.
One Lotus is set for Q2 2027 (premiere May 21-23, Singapore) and Ancients Awaken for Q3 (September 10-12, Antwerp).
Star Wars: Unlimited Gift Box lands November 20.
8 boosters and 3 exclusive promos: Moff Gideon, General Veers and Icons 2027 Chewbacca.
Teams of three battle at participating stores December 4-31 and January 8-28; the winning team gets a foil "Mutual Attraction" promo.
"Set Phasers to Superdrop" Secret Lair preorders open.
Star Trek reaches MTG Arena, and Pokémon Happy Meals return.
Magic | Star Trek release, plus Yu-Gi-Oh! Magnificent Maestros.
Flesh and Blood Mastery Pack: Assassin + Armory Deck: Dr. Mortimer.
